entities.name: Colosseum (Flavian Amphitheater)
entities.label: Place
entities.summary: 50,000-seat arena with 80 entrances. Four-story facade combining Doric, Ionic, and Corinthian orders. Retractable canvas awning (velarium). Hypogeum below with animal lifts.
